title: Spicy Stir-Fried Napa Cabbage
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make stir-fry dish that combines the crunch of napa cabbage with the heat of spicy peppers. This recipe is perfect for a quick and delicious meal.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the sliced jalapeños and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the diced Canadian bacon and cook until browned.
Add the chopped napa cabbage and cook until slightly wilted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
